GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (15 Oct 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 143)
APO 500
15 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Operations in China.
Reference memorandum S 226 from the Liaison Committee (Tokyo) for the Imperial Japanese Army and Navy to Colonel F. P. Munson, Subject: "Protection and other matters pertaining to Japanese at the North China ports", dated 12 October 1945, you are advised that should information concerning the operations of United States Forces in China become pertinent the Imperial Japanese Government will be advised thereof.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. ALLEN
/T/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
